# proto
> Multi-chain launchpad for fixed-supply tokens on Robinhood Chain and Arc Network.

proto is the premier multi-chain launchpad for fixed-supply tokens. Explore new launches, create tokens, and trade with permanently locked liquidity or dynamic bonding curves across Robinhood Chain and Arc Network.

## Products & Features
- Explore newest token launches on Robinhood Chain and Arc Network
- Dual Launch Architectures:
  - **v1**: Direct Uniswap V3 locked liquidity pool
  - **v2**: Constant-Product bonding curve with automatic graduation (4.2 ETH / 8,400 USDC)
- Decentralized trading interface with live charts and real-time order books
- Built-in metadata storage pinned to IPFS

## Public Surfaces
- App / Explore: https://proto.family/launchpad
- Create Token: https://proto.family/launchpad/create
- Analytics: https://proto.family/analytics
- Memestock Community Feed: https://proto.family/memestock
- Documentation: https://docs.proto.family
- Robots: https://proto.family/robots.txt
- Sitemap: https://proto.family/sitemap.xml

## Supported Networks
- **Robinhood Chain** (Chain ID: 4663): Native gas ETH (18 decimals)
- **Arc Testnet** (Chain ID: 5042002): Native gas USDC (6 decimals)
- Token Supply: Fixed 1,000,000,000 (18 decimals)
- Pool Fee: 1% (10000)
- Launch Fee: 0.0005 ETH (Robinhood) / 1 USDC (Arc)
